claims.statement: Across the comps spreadsheet excerpts provided, the Notes column is empty for all listed properties except Fenwick Distribution Hub.

The only non-blank entry in the Notes column is for Fenwick Distribution Hub, which states that its single largest tenant, Halvorsen Logistics Group, accounts for 38% of in-place annual base rent. This is a factual note about tenant concentration, not an instruction or command directed at any reader.
